unsupported: WebUSB is unavailable in this browser. Try an up-to-date browser with WebUSB support.
chooseHint: Connect a USB device with a data cable, then select it in the browser. If it is missing, check that your operating system recognizes it.
permissionError: USB access was denied. Check this site’s device permission and any browser or system restrictions.
selectionError: Could not select the device. Reconnect it and try again.
openError: The browser could not open the device. Other software, a missing compatible driver, or operating system permissions may be involved.
accessOk: The browser opened the device successfully.
noConfigurations: This device exposes no USB configurations.
noEndpoints: No endpoints in this alternate setting.
closeError: The device opened, but the browser could not release it. Reconnect the device before checking again.
